package.name: morai_grpc_vendor
package.description:
Vendored MORAI SIM gRPC interface. Contains the transitive import closure of the Actor, Sensor, Simulation and Simulator service files (31 files), the protobuf/gRPC C++ code generated from them at build time, thin clients for the Actor and Sensor services, 'MoraiLink' (a two-channel state/command link layer for the C++ engine whose public headers expose neither gRPC nor protobuf), the read-only measurement tool 'morai_probe' (including 'monitor', which watches what MORAI applies while something else drives), and 'morai_actuate', which drives the Ego (opt-in flag, restores mode and gear) to measure ControlVehicle consumption.
Files under proto/ are third-party and are reproduced verbatim; do not edit them. See PROVENANCE.md for the upstream URL, commit and license status.
BUILD PREREQUISITE NOT COVERED BY ROSDEP: this package needs the gRPC C++ runtime and codegen plugin, for which no rosdep key exists. Install them with 'sudo apt-get install -y libgrpc++-dev protobuf-compiler-grpc'. See README.md.
